checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
before=Path('specs/changes/HG-0001/evidence/concise/before.md').read_text()
after=Path('Product Decisions.md').read_text()
marker='## How to read this document'
assert before.split(marker,1)[0]==after.split(marker,1)[0]
ids=lambda text:re.findall(r'(?m)^### (PD-\d+)\.',text)
assert ids(before)==ids(after)==[f'PD-{n:02}' for n in range(1,38)]
assert len(re.findall(r'(?m)^\*\*#to-decide',before))==len(re.findall(r'(?m)^\*\*#to-decide',after))==28
links=lambda text:re.findall(r'\]\(<([^>]+)>\)',text)
assert links(before)==links(after)
for target in links(after):assert Path(target).is_file(),target
for item in re.findall(r'PD-\d+',after):assert item in ids(after)
assert len(re.findall(r'(?m)^Source:',after))==37
assert after.endswith('\n')
assert not any(line.rstrip()!=line for line in after.splitlines())
a=len(before.split(marker,1)[1].split());b=len(after.split(marker,1)[1].split())
print(json.dumps({'priority_section_unchanged':True,'preserved_decisions':37,'preserved_open_topics':28,'source_targets_unchanged_and_exist':True,'references_resolve':True,'lower_section_words_before':a,'lower_section_words_after':b,'reduction_percent':round(100*(1-b/a),1),'current_sha256':hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
PY
